info.name: Dinehub Admin API
info.description:
Sample Postman collection for the Dinehub admin API (`/api/v1/admin`), generated from `swagger/v1/swagger.yaml`.

Set `baseUrl` (for example `http://localhost:3000`) and `token` to an admin JWT. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`. The API also accepts the `jwt` cookie.

Obtain the token from `POST /api/v1/auth/login` with an admin user. List endpoints use `page` (default 1) and `per_page` (default 25, max 100).

Each request includes a sample JSON body where the endpoint accepts one, and a saved example response.

request.description: Returns order counts by status, successful payment revenue, active reservations, and customers who ordered. `today` is always the current date. `range` uses `from` and `to`, and defaults to today when either is omitted.
